eval_instructions: Offline, deterministic structural evals for /app-builder. See EVAL_GUIDE.md. Each eval's fixture is an App Spec (app-spec.json); the runner computes per-stage facts (author/plan/data/ui/app/verify/page) from the plugin's pure primitives and grades them against the common_stage_assertions + per-eval expect block. No live env, no network.
common_stage_assertions: author: validateAppSpec(plan profile) passes with no errors
author: spec-lint reports no errors
author: page quote warnings remain visible without rewriting approved names
plan: every planned item targets a known engine phase
security: the plan authors exactly one role per declared persona
security: each app-access persona role injects app-module read; opted-out personas do not
design: every mapped persona job resolves to a surface that exists
design: every custom table icon is described by what it depicts, not a token name
security: every persona privilege on an app-owned table resolves to a provisioned entity
security: each persona role grants exactly its declared job privileges (no over-grant)
data: schema-facts provision exactly the expected tables
data: schema-facts provision exactly the expected relationships
ui: wire-facts build exactly the expected views and charts
ui: explicit container names display flags and field state match authored intent
app: every sitemap subarea resolves to a concrete target (no dangling entity/page/dashboard)
app: every navigatesTo target resolves to a known page key
verify: reconcile against an all-present reader returns ok with no missing
verify: every required check kind actually ran
verify: served Main form order is checked or explicitly unavailable
generate-pages: no PAGEREF_ navigation target is left unresolved
teardown: the solution container is deleted last
teardown: every declared table has a teardown step
teardown: web resources are deleted after tables
round-trip: download hydrate recovers the same solution and tables
round-trip: the sitemap round-trips with the same subareas
round-trip: generative pages preserve their keys
round-trip: generative pages preserve their names and models
round-trip: authored directEntry survives unchanged
teardown: every declared dashboard has a teardown step
teardown: every declared command bar has a teardown step
teardown: every declared business rule and process flow has a teardown step
process: every business rule binds only columns the spec creates
process: every business rule compiles at least one condition and one action
process: every BPF step binds a field on the flow entity
process: every BPF stage is scoped to the flow entity (v1 is single-entity)
ui: enriched default views keep parent lookups and drop createdon
ui: each sub-grid is a full-width section titled by the child display name
ui: every compiled form places each field exactly once
ui: every compiled form places exactly the fields it intends to carry
round-trip: a lookup's shadow columns are never recovered as spec columns (#574)
round-trip: a download recovers no column the spec never authored

evals.prompt: Support desk: customers, tickets, and comments.
Orders app with an overview page that navigates to an order-detail page.
Assets app with a shared status choice, an on-click command, and an operations dashboard pinned to the nav.
Hardening: a lookup-heavy ticket table, an N:N to tags, a sub-grid, and valid relational sample data — exercises fixes #1/#2/#3/#4/#5/#7.
expectations: the ticket default view keeps new_customerid even though the table has 8 scalar columns (#2)
no enriched default view carries createdon (#7)
the N:N relationship name is the alphabetically-sorted new_tag_new_ticket (#3)
the customer form's ticket sub-grid is a 1-column full-width section titled 'Tickets' from the child pluralName (#5)
validateAppSpec accepts the relational sample data: the $parent match resolves and the Choice labels are declared (#1/#4)
quick create is enabled on the new_ticket table (#8)

evals.prompt: Process logic: a case table worked through a staged business process flow, with two business rules gating its fields — exercises businessProcessFlows[] and businessRules[].
expectations: the BPF stage order is Intake, Investigate, Resolve and every step binds a declared column
the BPF binds the relationship lookup new_accountref, not just the case table’s own columns
a rule with two conditions compiles both, ANDed, and neither is dropped
every business rule and the process flow each get exactly one teardown step

evals.prompt: Delivery: projects and work items on hand-authored forms — a two-form-column tab with 65/35 widths, two-column sections, a full-width title, a collapsed tab, and a polymorphic Customer lookup.
expectations: ui: an explicit layout compiles to the authored tab, form-column and section topology (it is not flattened)
ui: an authored colspan and rowspan survive into the compiled cell

evals.prompt: Reconcile a delivery form: insert Intake, reorder the Details and Administration tabs and the Notes and Execution sections, hide containers and fields, keep read-only state, split omitted column widths equally, preserve the Project Quick View, and serve Work Item before Work Item Review.
expectations: ui: an explicit layout compiles to the authored tab, form-column and section topology (it is not flattened)
ui: an authored colspan and rowspan survive into the compiled cell
verify: form reconciliation exercises an inserted tab and reordered existing containers
verify: Quick View bindings survive form reconciliation

evals.prompt: Download order pages whose own names differ from their sitemap titles. Unescape the PAC-stored Revenue \"FY\" name, preserve its gpt-4.1 model and table source, leave an absent model absent, and omit an invalid model with an explicit diagnostic.
expectations: round-trip: invalid downloaded models are omitted with explicit diagnostics

evals.prompt: Compare an identity-bound last-applied Orders baseline with edited page bytes. Only overview changed: classify a fast re-upload of that page alone. Adding cnt_priority instead requires a full data-model build, and comparing identical spec and source bytes must report noop.
expectations: changed-only: page bytes use a page-only fast path data-model edits use full and identical inputs are noop

evals.prompt: Give Orders and Tickets the same Information form, Queue view, and Status Summary chart names without cross-table duplicate warnings. Preserve approved page names verbatim: warn for Revenue "FY", but not for Clerk's Queue or Revenue “FY”. Same-table duplicates remain invalid for this fixture.
expectations: author: artifact-name warnings use per-table and form-type scope

evals.prompt: Shipments carry a Region from a shared choice whose numbers an integration depends on (North 1, South 2, Export 10), a bilingual Priority whose numbers must not change between environments (Low 1, High 5), and a Stage whose Held option must stay 100000005. The High Priority view filters on Priority 5.
expectations: author: option values the maker depends on are written as { value, label } and the spec asks for 2.21.0

evals.prompt: Contracts have a renewal date and a signed-on date that are calendar days, a site kickoff time that must read the same clock everywhere, a last-contact time shown in each user's own time zone, and a reviewed timestamp.
expectations: author: calendar days use DateOnly, a same-clock time uses TimeZoneIndependent, a per-user time is UserLocal or omitted

evals.prompt: Employee salary and medical notes are confidential: the HR team (team id 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111) may read and update them, and may also enter medical notes on a new employee; Payroll may read salary but nobody is named for it yet.
expectations: author: confidential columns are isSecured with explicit profiles; assignees are named, never inferred, and an unassigned profile says so

evals.prompt: This app should only show the Summary form for Items.
expectations: author: "only these forms" lists them in app.mainForms with mainFormsOnUpdate "exact"; "add a form" never asks for exact

evals.prompt: A new Project Costs app: projects in the navigation, plus a chart of expenses by category in the app.
expectations: author: a new app with a chart or view of a table outside its navigation pins the declared artifacts

evals.prompt: A new Help Desk app: tickets that users find by ticket number, customers they find by email, a list of open tickets that shows each ticket's customer name, and a chart of tickets by priority.
expectations: author: every view and chart of a new app is declared, and no other kind carries reconcile or a command key
author: each new table searches on its primary name plus the identifiers the prompt names
author: a column from a related table joins that table on the view that shows it, and only there

evals.prompt: Declared web resource: the process-logic case app, where the maker asked the build to keep one HTML web resource's content in step with the spec on every rebuild — exercises reconcile: "declared" on webResources[].
expectations: the BPF stage order is Intake, Investigate, Resolve and every step binds a declared column
the BPF binds the relationship lookup new_accountref, not just the case table’s own columns
a rule with two conditions compiles both, ANDed, and neither is dropped
every business rule and the process flow each get exactly one teardown step
author: a web resource the maker asked to keep in step is declared, never shared, and is the only kind besides views and charts that carries reconcile

evals.prompt: A Field Requests app, shipped as version 1.2.0.0: requests with a title, a requester email and a priority. It calls our dispatch service, whose base URL and API key differ per environment (the key is a secret), sends field notices through SharePoint, offers an Escalate action on a request that takes a reason and answers whether it was accepted, and flags requests that have the same requester email.
expectations: author: each configuration item the prompt needs is declared, and no value that differs per environment is in the spec

evals.prompt: A new Field Visits app for site visits, branded: Contoso blue (#0F6CBD), a dark blue header with white text, and our Contoso logo in the header.
expectations: author: a theme is declared only on an explicit branding ask, with the asked colours, no unasked font, and a declared image web resource as the logo, never a URL
verify: a declared app theme is read back once, as API state, and passes only when live

evals.prompt: A new Equipment Loans app: loans of equipment to staff with a status and a due date, a list of open loans and a chart of loans by status.
expectations: author: a new app opts into stable create ids with the 2.21.0 floor, and a downloaded or existing spec never gains them
author: the skill tells the maker that an unsent local edit stops a stable build and running again does not merge it

evals.prompt: A Site Inspections app: sites with their inspections and open issues. Lay out the site form myself and keep it that way on every rebuild: the name across the full width, the site code read-only, the region shown, the address two rows tall, a grid of inspections and a grid of issues, and run Site.onLoad from cnt_site.js when it opens.
expectations: ui: an explicit layout compiles to the authored tab, form-column and section topology (it is not flattened)
ui: an authored colspan and rowspan survive into the compiled cell

evals.prompt: A Field Ops app for work orders with a Field Operations dashboard: a wide list of open work orders, a chart of work orders by status and a tall crew map from https://contoso.example/field-map. Keep its tiles the way the spec says on every rebuild, but leave any tile I add in Maker alone.

A Service Desk app for service requests. Keep two business rules the way the spec says on every rebuild: a closed request needs a resolution and its notes lock, and a request in progress with no assignee shows an error on every form.
